notes.title: Full version of Lesson Learned coming in May
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/35377707/f430b8fe4c6bbd6bc98de34971ea0db46baab19d.png[/img]

Great news for every fan of tower defense games! The full version of [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1563870/Lesson_Learned/]Lesson Learned[/url][/b] will be available on [b]May 29, 2024[/b], on [b]Steam[/b] and [b]Xbox[/b]!

[b]Watch the teaser announcing the date of Lesson Learned:[/b]

https://youtu.be/RC2FGmXwU6E
In this hilarious tower defense game, Frank and a campaign led through different historical eras await you. Defend your mobile base with a succession of defense towers and distribute tasks among the minions - Frank's classmates.

You can play [b]Lesson Learned[/b] in solo or cooperative mode. Invite friends and try your hand at split-screen campaign mode.

Play the free prologue [b]Lesson Learned: Cult of the Elizabeth[/b], which is now available. In it, you will learn the necessary mechanics and face the bloody Countess Elizabeth Batory. Also add [b]Lesson Learned[/b] to your wishlist so you don't miss the release.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1563870/Lesson_Learned/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2252360/Lesson_Learned_Cult_of_the_Elizabeth/

Gaming Factory

notes.title: Pre-release Gameplay Stream
notes.notes:
[h3]Greetings Foodballers![/h3]
Foodtruck Arena is coming out 02.07.2021. We want to share the gameplay of our game so we are launching Stream on Steam Store Page. Hope You will like it. Demo of the game is already playable on Steam and allows to free match with 3 out of 8 characters. Play local or via Steam Remote Play!

To play via Steam Remote Play simply Run the game, click Shift+Tab for Your Steam overlay, right-click Your friend and invite his/her to Play!

The game is coming out for PC and Nintendo Switch. Check out the Release Date Trailer!

notes.notes:

We would love to invite You to our Steam Game Festival demo after a few months of improvements and work on full version both for PC and Switch. We deployed two big updates for demo where we added Steam Remote Works and ton of gameplay, AI, physics and graphics improvements. 
Check [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1182280/announcements/detail/2930117621250221595]Update#1[/url] and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1182280/announcements/detail/3064105417949610597]Update#2[/url] for details

Don't forget to share Your feedback and cool plays on our [url=https://discord.gg/sSxtRJG]Discord Server![/url]
Yours - Foodtruck Arena Team
